note: Well-known places, checked before the geocoder. Each match is a list of phrases that must all appear in the address (compared on folded text, token by token), and only inside the listed cities. Coordinates come from geocoding each place's query once; see scripts/geocode.ts. A place may carry a fixed "point" instead, with a note saying how it was verified. Places whose lookups could not be verified are left out, so their addresses fall back to the geocoder or to city level. A place may list except: names that contain its own but lie elsewhere ("Al-Faisal Town" is not Faisal Town); an address naming one does not match the place.
